listings.Job Description: Build upon your classroom studies through our Hotel Internship Program opportunities. You will learn first-hand about a hotel's operations. Our Hotel Internship Program allows you to truly experience the industry from the ground up, where our founders and many of our leaders began. You will get immersed in Marriott's culture and business and find your true calling in the travel industry. Our internships are typically available in many different areas of the hotel. By gaining hands-on experience in the exciting world of hotel management, you’ll be better prepared to pursue opportunities post graduation.
listings.Job Requirements: Follow strict personal hygiene procedures to ensure safe food handling. Adhere to food safety policies, including HACCP guidelines and Cold Chain compliance. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, maintaining quality and presentation standards. Monitor food quality during preparation using HACCP forms and production charts. Safely and appropriately use kitchen tools and equipment, ensuring proper handling and engagement of safety devices. Use measuring tools to precisely measure ingredients and portion sizes. Report work-related accidents or injuries promptly. Follow company, hotel, and department safety and security policies and procedures. Adhere to Marriott International Hotels Limited Regional Office policies and procedures. Actively listen and respond positively to guest questions, concerns, and requests. Anticipate and address guests' service needs professionally and promptly. Communicate effectively with guests and co-workers, using clear and appropriate language.
